## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 172 captures during December 2018. This report summarises activity for the month and presents the available image-quality and grading measures. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing the volume of work completed at the site during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 5 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.9, providing a measure of the proportion of captures that could not be used for grading. This result is reported alongside the overall capture activity to support routine monitoring of image quality at East City Eye Clinic.

## Grading

A total of 25 results were recorded as referable during December 2018. The median lag from capture to grading was 8. The referable result count and the median lag are presented together to describe both grading outcomes and the time taken for results to be processed. These measures provide the monthly operational position for the site and can be reviewed with subsequent reports to monitor activity, image quality, and grading performance.
